extraction.Name: Sanford Lunderman
extraction.Recorded patent: the patent was recorded by Volz Abstract Company on June 11, 1918
extraction.Buyer: conveyed by deed to W. H. Tackett for $3700
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612821; Southwest quarter section 29, township 97, north of range 74; receipt for the patent was signed by the allottee February 8, 1918, the patent having been mailed to him in Hawaii; on May 7, 1918, while in Honolulu the land was conveyed by deed to W. H. Tackett for $3700
